column1: # Trigger-test prompts for tests/run-trigger-tests.sh (opt-in, spends model quota).
# Columns, tab separated: id, expected skill, prompt.
# The expected column takes alternatives with | (any one counts as a hit).
# A row whose expected skills do not exist under skillet/skills/ is skipped,
# so a prompt can be added before its skill ships.
# Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
